title: BRICS Bloc Urges 'Maximum Restraint' in Middle East Amid Heightened Regional Tensions
snippet: World leaders at the annual BRICS summit issued a joint declaration calling for urgent de-escalation and a cease-fire in the Middle East.
content:
In a joint declaration issued Wednesday, leaders of the expanding BRICS economic group called for "maximum restraint" in the Middle East, voicing deep concern over escalating military actions that threaten to plunge the region into a wider conflict.

A Push for Diplomatic Solutions

Meeting at their annual summit, representatives from member nations—including Russia, China, India, Brazil, and South Africa, alongside newly admitted members—emphasized the critical need for an immediate cease-fire and unhindered humanitarian access. The joint statement highlights growing international alarm over spiraling violence across Gaza, Lebanon, and the broader region.

Redefining Global Influence

The collective stance underscores the bloc's intent to assert greater influence on global security matters traditionally dominated by Western powers. By advocating for a multipolar diplomatic approach, BRICS leaders aimed to position the group as a major voice on the world stage, calling for renewed commitment to international law and reformed global governance.
